title: Sample Paper: Robust Self-Supervised Pretraining under Noisy Image Crops
abstract: We study the effect of crop-level label noise on contrastive self-supervised learning and propose a noise-aware view selection strategy that improves linear probe accuracy by 1.8% on ImageNet-100.

sections.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: Contrastive SSL assumes that two random crops of the same image are semantically equivalent, which is violated for low-overlap crops.
We propose a noise estimator that downweights low-overlap pairs during pretraining.

sections.heading: Method
paragraphs: We compute a soft alignment score from a small auxiliary network and use it to scale the contrastive loss term per pair.
Training is otherwise identical to MoCo-v3.

sections.heading: Experiments
paragraphs: On ImageNet-100 we report linear probe top-1 of 80.1 vs. 78.3 for MoCo-v3 baseline.
Transfer to CIFAR-100 improves by 1.1 points.
